card.name: Pizzica
card.tagline: Salento's healing dance — three forms, one driving 6/8 rhythm, revived in the 1990s as southern Italy’s cultural rebirth.
card.profile: Pizzica is a popular Italian folk dance, originally from the Salento peninsula, in Apulia, and later spreading throughout the rest of Apulia and the regions of Calabria and eastern Basilicata. It is part of the larger family of tarantella.
